import sys
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.types import DecimalType

# 1. Initialize AWS Glue
args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ["JOB_NAME"])

sc = SparkContext.getOrCreate()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session

job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args["JOB_NAME"], args)

# 2. Read existing Silver tables
items = spark.table(
    "globalpartners_silver_db.order_items"
)

options = spark.table(
    "globalpartners_silver_db.order_item_options"
)

dates = spark.table(
    "globalpartners_silver_db.date_dim"
)

# 3. Calculate revenue using PDF unit-price rules
# Missing customer IDs cannot be assigned customer CLV.
# USD-only scope avoids mixing different currencies.
items_clean = (
    items
    .filter(F.col("user_id").isNotNull())
    .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
    .withColumn(
        "order_date",
        F.to_date("creation_time_utc")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "item_revenue",
        F.col("item_price").cast("decimal(20,2)")
        * F.col("item_quantity")
    )
)

# 4. Aggregate option charges BEFORE joining
options_agg = (
    options
    .groupBy("order_id", "lineitem_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(
            F.col("option_price").cast("decimal(20,2)")
            * F.col("option_quantity")
        ).alias("option_revenue")
    )
)

# 5. Join item and option revenue
line_revenue = (
    items_clean.alias("i")
    .join(
        options_agg.alias("o"),
        ["order_id", "lineitem_id"],
        "left"
    )
    .withColumn(
        "option_revenue",
        F.coalesce(
            F.col("option_revenue"),
            F.lit(0).cast("decimal(20,2)")
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "total_revenue",
        F.col("item_revenue")
        + F.col("option_revenue")
    )
)

# 6. Aggregate to one row per customer/order
order_revenue = (
    line_revenue
    .groupBy("user_id", "order_id", "order_date")
    .agg(
        F.sum("total_revenue").alias("order_revenue")
    )
)

# 7. Aggregate daily customer activity
daily_revenue = (
    order_revenue
    .groupBy("user_id", "order_date")
    .agg(
        F.sum("order_revenue").alias("daily_revenue"),
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("daily_orders")
    )
)

# 8. Join existing Silver date dimension
calendar = dates.select(
    F.col("date_key").alias("calendar_date"),
    "year",
    "month",
    "week",
    "day_of_week",
    "is_weekend",
    "is_holiday"
).dropDuplicates(["calendar_date"])

daily_revenue = (
    daily_revenue
    .join(
        calendar,
        daily_revenue.order_date == calendar.calendar_date,
        "left"
    )
    .drop("calendar_date")
)

# 9. Calculate cumulative observed customer CLV
customer_window = (
    Window
    .partitionBy("user_id")
    .orderBy("order_date")
    .rowsBetween(
        Window.unboundedPreceding,
        Window.currentRow
    )
)

daily_clv = (
    daily_revenue
    .withColumn(
        "cumulative_clv",
        F.sum("daily_revenue").over(customer_window)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "cumulative_orders",
        F.sum("daily_orders").over(customer_window)
    )
)

# 10. Calculate overall observed customer CLV
customer_totals = (
    daily_clv
    .groupBy("user_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("daily_revenue").alias("customer_total_clv")
    )
)

# 11. Assign CLV segments: top 20%, middle 60%, bottom 20%
rank_window = Window.orderBy(
    F.col("customer_total_clv").desc(),
    F.col("user_id")
)

customer_segments = (
    customer_totals
    .withColumn(
        "clv_percentile",
        F.ntile(100).over(rank_window)
    )
    .withColumn(
        "clv_segment",
        F.when(
            F.col("clv_percentile") <= 20,
            "High CLV"
        )
        .when(
            F.col("clv_percentile") <= 80,
            "Medium CLV"
        )
        .otherwise("Low CLV")
    )
)

# 12. Combine daily metrics and customer segments
final_df = (
    daily_clv
    .join(
        customer_segments.select(
            "user_id",
            "customer_total_clv",
            "clv_segment"
        ),
        "user_id",
        "left"
    )
)
# Ensure Gold output uses consistent data types
final_df = (
    final_df
    .withColumn("daily_revenue", F.col("daily_revenue").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("cumulative_clv", F.col("cumulative_clv").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("customer_total_clv", F.col("customer_total_clv").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("daily_orders", F.col("daily_orders").cast("bigint"))
    .withColumn("cumulative_orders", F.col("cumulative_orders").cast("bigint"))
)
# 13. Write Gold Parquet output
output_path = (
    "s3://globalpartners-medallion-593271843946/"
    "gold/daily_customer_clv/"
)

(
    final_df
    .write
    .mode("overwrite")
    .format("parquet")
    .partitionBy("year")
    .save(output_path)
)

print("Daily Customer CLV transformation completed.")

job.commit()
